requirements.title: Push/pull status
requirements.description: When a push is requested, the system MUST inspect outgoing historical file sizes and refuse blocked or incomplete scans before transfer. When a human approves an exact eligible preview, the system MUST prepare verified isolated recovery artifacts without modifying the source repository.

validation.notes: Covers remote readiness, upstream selection, and safe fake-runner outcomes.
Refusal before writer for blocked, incomplete and stale previews.
Historical deletion, exact thresholds, unknown host, source drift and incomplete metadata.
Command and storage failures, durable reservation and interrupted operation idempotency.
Temporary repositories prove independent backup restore, four-commit repair, dirty workspace preservation and exact push source.
Consent, honest backup scope, stale/unknown outcomes, repository switching and read-only recovery status.
Ephemeral HTTP handlers, request-bound human intents, leased artifacts, retained-operation discovery, remote drift and bundle corruption; optional BAS fixture uses the production dialog.
